verdict.rationale: Orb exposes a REST API with SDKs in six languages, endpoints for customers, subscriptions, invoices, credit-balance alerts, revenue recognition, and cursor-based pagination for listing resources — all of which an agent could technically query for billing state (orb-docs-27, orb-docs-29, orb-docs-22, orb-docs-26). However, there is no explicit MRR-reporting endpoint, no dedicated delinquent-accounts or upcoming-renewals query surface, and no MCP server or agent-native interface documented; a probe found no discoverable OpenAPI spec (orb-probe-2), and community commentary notes MRR reporting itself is a known pain point (orb-comm-1). Missing for 10: dedicated MRR/analytics query endpoint, delinquent-account and renewal-specific endpoints, an agent-facing (MCP or natural-language) interface, and a machine-readable API schema.
